criteria.name: Mechanism and assumptions
criteria.description: Identify first-price buyer mechanism, total bidder count, independence, value distribution, reserve and constraints before selecting a model.

criteria.name: Arithmetic and boundaries
criteria.description: Reproduce uniform benchmarks, reserve cases and abstention; reject invalid inputs rather than clamping them.

criteria.name: Common-value evidence
criteria.description: Condition on winning using a supported signal model or state missing evidence; no universal winner-curse discount.

criteria.name: Action limits
criteria.description: Separate benchmark from constrained action; state uncertainty and do not submit bids.
